plugins.name: context-budget-statusline
plugins.description: Claude Code statusline that tracks cumulative session token usage and color-codes it against configurable thresholds (default: amber at 100k, red at 150k) so you clear context before it bloats.

plugins.name: committing-with-intent
plugins.description: Commit messages that explain why not what, plus hard guardrails against force-push and direct-to-main pushes without confirmation.

plugins.name: drafting-pr-descriptions
plugins.description: PR descriptions structured around what/why, risk, and testing actually done, matching the repo's own PR template instead of generic AI-sounding filler.

plugins.name: dont-lie
plugins.description: Blocks stating unverified facts — file/function behavior, tests, API signatures, numbers — unless grounded in something read, run, or said this session.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Strips AI writing tells from prose and code comments/commits/PRs. Inspired by Wikipedia's Signs of AI Writing project and blader/humanizer.
